<?php
// بيانات صافي على السيرفر: كل الأجهزة تقرا وتكتب نفس البيانات
header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
header('Cache-Control: no-store');
$dir = __DIR__ . '/data';
if (!is_dir($dir)) { @mkdir($dir, 0700, true); }
if (!file_exists($dir . '/.htaccess')) { @file_put_contents($dir . '/.htaccess', "Require all denied\nDeny from all\n"); }
$sd = $dir . '/sync';
if (!is_dir($sd)) { @mkdir($sd, 0700, true); }
function out($a, $code = 200) { http_response_code($code); echo json_encode($a, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_PRESERVE_ZERO_FRACTION); exit; }
$key = isset($_SERVER['HTTP_X_SAFI_KEY']) ? (string)$_SERVER['HTTP_X_SAFI_KEY'] : '';
if (strlen($key) < 4) out(['ok' => false, 'err' => 'nokey'], 401);
$kf = $dir . '/.key';
if (!file_exists($kf)) { file_put_contents($kf, password_hash($key, PASSWORD_DEFAULT)); @chmod($kf, 0600); }
if (!password_verify($key, trim(file_get_contents($kf)))) out(['ok' => false, 'err' => 'badkey'], 403);

// arr = قائمة عناصر بمعرف، obj = كائن ينحفظ خاصية خاصية، val = قيمة وحدة، max = رقم ياخذ الأكبر
$TYPES = ['customers' => 'arr', 'orders' => 'arr', 'products' => 'arr', 'settings' => 'obj', 'counter' => 'max', 'layout' => 'val', 'mix' => 'val'];
$sf = $sd . '/state.json';
$fp = fopen($sd . '/.lock', 'c');
// نخلي الكائنات كائنات (حتى {} ما يصير [])
function load($sf) {
  $st = file_exists($sf) ? json_decode(file_get_contents($sf)) : null;
  if (!is_object($st)) $st = (object)['rev' => 0, 'k' => new stdClass()];
  if (!isset($st->k) || !is_object($st->k)) $st->k = new stdClass();
  return $st;
}
function idOf($k, $x) {
  if (isset($x->id) && $x->id !== '' && $x->id !== null) return (string)$x->id;
  if ($k === 'orders') return 'o' . ($x->ts ?? 0) . '-' . ($x->num ?? 0);
  return '';
}
function build($k, $e, $type) {
  if ($type === 'arr') {
    $v = array_values((array)($e->items ?? new stdClass()));
    if ($k === 'products') usort($v, function ($a, $b) { return ($a->_o ?? 0) <=> ($b->_o ?? 0); });
    else usort($v, function ($a, $b) { return (($b->ts ?? $b->created ?? 0) <=> ($a->ts ?? $a->created ?? 0)); });
    return $v;
  }
  if ($type === 'obj') return $e->props ?? new stdClass();
  return $e->v ?? null;
}
function keysSince($st, $since, $TYPES, $also = []) {
  $r = new stdClass();
  foreach ($st->k as $k => $e) if (isset($TYPES[$k]) && (($e->rev ?? 0) > $since || in_array($k, $also, true))) $r->$k = build($k, $e, $TYPES[$k]);
  return $r;
}
$a = isset($_GET['a']) ? $_GET['a'] : '';

if ($a === 'get') {
  flock($fp, LOCK_SH); $st = load($sf); flock($fp, LOCK_UN);
  $since = isset($_GET['since']) ? (int)$_GET['since'] : 0;
  out(['ok' => true, 'rev' => (int)$st->rev, 'keys' => keysSince($st, $since, $TYPES), 'empty' => (int)$st->rev === 0]);
}

if ($a === 'put' && $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
  $body = file_get_contents('php://input');
  if (strlen($body) > 30 * 1024 * 1024) out(['ok' => false, 'err' => 'size'], 400);
  $j = json_decode($body);
  if (!is_object($j) || !isset($j->keys) || !is_object($j->keys)) out(['ok' => false, 'err' => 'json'], 400);
  flock($fp, LOCK_EX);
  $st = load($sf);
  // أول مرة: ما نقبل إلا جهاز بيه بيانات حقيقية (حتى جهاز جديد فاضي ما يمسح شي)
  if ((int)$st->rev === 0 && empty($j->seed)) { flock($fp, LOCK_UN); out(['ok' => false, 'err' => 'notseeded'], 409); }
  $rev = (int)$st->rev + 1; $now = (int)round(microtime(true) * 1000); $changed = [];
  foreach ($j->keys as $k => $ch) {
    if (!isset($TYPES[$k]) || !is_object($ch)) continue;
    $t = $TYPES[$k]; $e = $st->k->$k ?? new stdClass();
    if ($t === 'arr') {
      $items = $e->items ?? new stdClass(); $del = $e->del ?? new stdClass();
      foreach (($ch->up ?? []) as $x) {
        if (!is_object($x)) continue; $id = idOf($k, $x); if ($id === '') continue;
        $items->$id = $x; unset($del->$id);
      }
      foreach (($ch->del ?? []) as $id) { $id = (string)$id; unset($items->$id); $del->$id = $now; }
      foreach ($del as $id => $tm) if ($tm < $now - 60 * 86400000) unset($del->$id);
      $e = (object)['items' => $items, 'del' => $del, 'rev' => $rev];
    } elseif ($t === 'obj') {
      $p = $e->props ?? new stdClass();
      foreach (($ch->set ?? new stdClass()) as $pk => $pv) $p->$pk = $pv;
      foreach (($ch->del ?? []) as $pk) unset($p->$pk);
      $e = (object)['props' => $p, 'rev' => $rev];
    } elseif ($t === 'max') {
      $e = (object)['v' => max((int)($e->v ?? 0), (int)($ch->v ?? 0)), 'rev' => $rev];
    } else {
      $e = (object)['v' => $ch->v ?? null, 'rev' => $rev];
    }
    $st->k->$k = $e; $changed[] = $k;
  }
  if ($changed) {
    $st->rev = $rev;
    $tmp = $sf . '.tmp';
    file_put_contents($tmp, json_encode($st, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_PRESERVE_ZERO_FRACTION)); rename($tmp, $sf);
  }
  flock($fp, LOCK_UN);
  out(['ok' => true, 'rev' => (int)$st->rev, 'keys' => keysSince($st, (int)($j->since ?? 0), $TYPES, $changed)]);
}
out(['ok' => false, 'err' => 'bad'], 400);

<?php
// نسخ احتياطية لنظام صافي: حفظ تلقائي على الاستضافة واسترجاع
header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
header('Cache-Control: no-store');
$dir = __DIR__ . '/data';
if (!is_dir($dir)) { @mkdir($dir, 0700, true); }
if (!file_exists($dir . '/.htaccess')) { @file_put_contents($dir . '/.htaccess', "Require all denied\nDeny from all\n"); }
function out($a, $code = 200) { http_response_code($code); echo json_encode($a, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE); exit; }
$key = isset($_SERVER['HTTP_X_SAFI_KEY']) ? (string)$_SERVER['HTTP_X_SAFI_KEY'] : '';
if (strlen($key) < 4) out(['ok' => false, 'err' => 'nokey'], 401);
$kf = $dir . '/.key';
if (!file_exists($kf)) { file_put_contents($kf, password_hash($key, PASSWORD_DEFAULT)); @chmod($kf, 0600); }
if (!password_verify($key, trim(file_get_contents($kf)))) out(['ok' => false, 'err' => 'badkey'], 403);
$a = isset($_GET['a']) ? $_GET['a'] : '';
if ($a === 'save' && $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
  $body = file_get_contents('php://input');
  if (strlen($body) < 10 || strlen($body) > 30 * 1024 * 1024) out(['ok' => false, 'err' => 'size'], 400);
  $j = json_decode($body, true);
  if (!is_array($j) || !isset($j['settings'])) out(['ok' => false, 'err' => 'json'], 400);
  $jj = $j; unset($jj['exported']); $h = md5(json_encode($jj));
  $last = $dir . '/.last';
  if (file_exists($last) && trim(file_get_contents($last)) === $h) out(['ok' => true, 'same' => true]);
  date_default_timezone_set('Asia/Baghdad');
  $f = date('Ymd-His') . '.json';
  file_put_contents($dir . '/' . $f, $body, LOCK_EX);
  file_put_contents($last, $h);
  $all = glob($dir . '/[0-9]*.json'); sort($all);
  // نخلي آخر 300 نسخة
  while (count($all) > 300) { @unlink(array_shift($all)); }
  out(['ok' => true, 'f' => $f]);
}
if ($a === 'list') {
  $all = glob($dir . '/[0-9]*.json'); rsort($all);
  $r = [];
  foreach (array_slice($all, 0, 300) as $p) { $r[] = ['f' => basename($p), 'size' => filesize($p)]; }
  out(['ok' => true, 'list' => $r]);
}
if ($a === 'get') {
  $f = isset($_GET['f']) ? basename($_GET['f']) : '';
  if (!preg_match('/^\d{8}-\d{6}\.json$/', $f) || !file_exists($dir . '/' . $f)) out(['ok' => false, 'err' => 'nofile'], 404);
  header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
  readfile($dir . '/' . $f); exit;
}
out(['ok' => false, 'err' => 'bad'], 400);
